title: Small editions
description: An expandable collection of sculptural art prints keeps its place in a contact sheet.
useCase: Preview a portfolio image without losing the surrounding collection.
reducedMotion: Live reduced-motion preferences remove interpolation and decorative playback. All content and native controls remain available. Keyboard changes settle immediately.
limitations: Original demonstration content; adapt labels and state to the host product.
look: Warm grey page with a two-by-two grid of off-white mats framing sculptural forms on tan, teal, brick red and pale blue, with serif captions.
motion: Clicking a print expands it from its cell to fill the sheet over 0.5 s ease-out while the others fade to 25%. The real layout changes once; transforms animate the visual difference and inverse scaling preserves the caption's proportions.
adapt: The click handler captures visible `.print` bounds before updating `selected`. `useLayoutEffect` commits the new layout and uses WAAPI transforms to animate from those bounds; caption keyframes apply inverse scale. Existing animations cancel and retarget from the visible state. `[data-muted=true]` dims siblings. Replace `names` and the CSS-drawn art with your images.
